 Travel
 Travel on a non-commercial chartered or private aircraft from: Paris, France
To: Dinard, France
From: 2019-04-05
To: 2019-04-06
Offered by: Government of France
Circumstances: NATO ministerial meetings were held in Washington DC, USA on April 3, and the G7 Foreign Ministers Meeting was held in Dinard, France on April 4. The Government of France arranged plane transportation from Paris to Dinard to allow delegates to arrive in time for the G7 FMM. 
I was accompanied by Vincent Garneau, Deputy Chief of Staff and Director of Policy, and Alex Lawrence, Director of Communications.
This travel was required in my capacity as a public office holder.

Alex Lawrence, Director of Communications
Dahlia Stein, Director of Operations.
Date: 2018-10-30
Offered by: Government of Israel
Circumstances: Aerial tour and briefing of Israel, its borders, and the security situation in the region
This travel was required in my capacity as Minister of Foreign Affairs
 Travel on a non-commercial chartered or private aircraft
From: Dhaka, Dhaka District, Bangladesh
To: Cox's Bazar, Chittagong Division, Bangladesh
Date: May 4, 2018
Offered by the Government of Bangladesh
Circumstances: 
Delegates attending the 45th session of the Council of Foreign Ministers of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation in Dhaka visited a Rohingya refugee camp in Cox’s Bazar. The Government of Bangladesh arranged plane transportation for delegation members. The flight was necessary to attend a briefing by the Bangladeshi government in Cox's Bazar on the situation there and how it has been addressing the crisis.
I was accompanied by Laurence Deschamps-Laporte, Director of Policy, and Adam Austen, Press Secretary.
This travel was required in my capacity as a public office holder.
 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Minister of Finance, I recused myself on August 3, 2023, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding the Department of Finance’s process to hire a new senior advisor in the Office of the Deputy Minister in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of a family friend, Mr. Manish Srivastava.
 On November 4, 2021, in the exercise of my official duties, I recused myself from all discussions and decisions pertaining to the initial public offering of Economical Mutual Insurance Company in order to avoid any opportunity to further my private interest.
